findings.title: Contact endpoint is a branded-email amplification / phishing vector — attacker controls confirmation recipient AND echoed body, gated only by one Turnstile solve, no rate limit
GA4 + PostHog fire before/without consent — GDPR/ePrivacy/Dutch cookie-law exposure (documented owner-accepted decision)
CSP defines only frame-ancestors — add object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' (cheap); script-src allowlist de-scoped by owner
Dead reveal.tsx (zero callsites, verified) ships the entire framer-motion bundle + dead CSS keyframes
No timeout on Turnstile + Postmark fetches — hung upstream stalls the Worker until platform kill
Zero observability in the contact Worker — every failure path is silent in production
lib/content.ts readFileSync at module scope — a missing/renamed .md crashes the whole static build with a bare ENOENT
Turnstile always-pass TEST secret reachable on any production host not in the exact-match TURNSTILE_ENFORCED_HOSTS set (future custom domains / aliases)
handleOpenChange schedules an uncleared 250ms setTimeout — close→reopen within 250ms wipes a live Turnstile token, disabling submit
NVGH Logo.jpeg filename contains a space — excluded from AVIF/WebP optimization, srcset-breakage risk
No automated test harness — the contact Function's prod-only logic (enforced-host fail-closed, honeypot, Postmark batch index-0 parse) ships with zero coverage and cannot run under next dev
JSON-LD Organization logo is an SVG (verified) — ineligible for Google logo rich result (needs raster)
accordion.tsx uses `ref as any` — type-safety hole; sibling primitives in the same file use React.ElementRef
National2 heading font: no <link rel=preload> + raw OTF (no woff2 subset) → heading FOUT on every page
Client treats every non-OK contact response as a generic error — ignores server field-level error codes (name/email/message)
api-catalog omits the one real endpoint (POST /api/contact) and its Turnstile gate
PhaseExplorer renders only Phase 01 in static HTML — 5/6 curriculum phases invisible to no-JS crawlers/agents
Footer nav order diverges from documented canonical order (Puppycursus/Rassenkeuze + Over ons/FAQ swapped) — verified
Navbar CTA is 'Start vandaag → /prijzen' but CLAUDE.md documents 'Start gratis → app.letsdog.nl' — docs/code drift (verified); CLAUDE.md likely stale
sitemap.ts LAST_MODIFIED hardcoded 2026-05-30 — stale, predates 2026-06-11+ content changes
llms.txt missing ip-overdrachtsverklaring page (in sitemap) + the €39,50 consultation product
Manifest reuses the 512px icon for both any + maskable purposes — maskable display clips the logo

verified_clean_no_finding: All 11 target=_blank links carry rel=noopener noreferrer (reverse-tabnabbing mitigated)
VARIANT_WIDTHS [384,512,768,1280] === optimize-images WIDTHS — no image-srcset drift
No direct gtag()/posthog.capture() calls outside lib/analytics.ts + the analytics module
escapeHtml omits single-quote but user input lands only in HTML text nodes, never attributes — not exploitable
Email header injection impossible (JSON to Postmark REST API; EMAIL_RE forbids whitespace)
rassenkeuze iframe: hardcoded origin + URLSearchParams re-encoding = no open-redirect/SSRF; window.location.search-in-useEffect is the documented-correct static-export pattern
dangerouslySetInnerHTML in ga4.tsx + json-ld.tsx receive only validated/constant/escaped input
Server secrets (POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN, TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY) are env-only, never NEXT_PUBLIC; not in client bundle
Turnstile host-gated fail-closed fix from a prior review is present in current code
